title: Froggo
description: Makes all name-tagged animals tameable! And when they are tamed, the become immortal!
body:
Froggo lets you tame any animal in the game — not just frogs.

  Give an animal a name tag, then right-click it while holding its breeding food to tame it. Your new companion will follow you wherever you go, and since
  they're yours, they can't be harmed by anything.

  Features:
  - Tame any named animal — works on frogs, cows, pigs, sheep, chickens, and more
  - Right-click to sit/stand — toggle whether your companion follows you or stays put
  - Right-click with food to heal — restore health using the animal's breeding food
  - Immortal companions — tamed animals cannot take damage from any source
  - Persistent — tamed status, owner, and sitting state survive world reloads
  - Server-side only — no need to install on client

  How to tame:
  1. Name the animal with a Name Tag
  2. Hold its breeding food (e.g. slimeball for frogs, wheat for cows)
  3. Right-click it
